name: scroll-pin
purpose: Pin a stable section element while giving its entered state a restrained opacity and transform reveal.

cwvImpact.rationale: The pinned container retains its document space and its visual transition uses only opacity and transform.

accessibility.reducedMotionFallback: Disables pinning and motion, then leaves the content visible in normal flow.

cwvTripwire.layoutShift: The visual transition is limited to opacity and transform on a stable container.
cwvTripwire.longAnimation: A bounded host semantic duration token is required for the entered-state transition.
cwvTripwire.durationCap: Timing is limited to the host semantic duration tokens.
